title.zh: 泊松过程 · 随机到达的规律
title.en: The Poisson Process · The Pattern in Random Arrivals

desc.zh: 放射性计数、排队来人：事件随机到达，却有精确的统计规律——间隔是指数分布，窗口里的个数是泊松分布。
desc.en: Radioactive counts, people joining a queue: arrivals are random yet follow exact statistics — gaps are exponential, counts per window are Poisson.
